motions.motion: forward a NEGATIVE recommendation to the City Council to deny an application by Michael Ault to amend Title 13, Chapter 13.100 Appendix A of the City of Holladay Land Use Code to add Short-Term Rentals as a Conditional Use to the Table of Allowed Uses, based upon the following findings: 1. Public engagement opportunities associated with the 2025 General Plan update regarding specific land uses including but not limited to office, commercial, residential, and short-term rentals would allow greater input and direction as to what the larger community envisions for various areas and uses within Holladay. 2. The Goals and Policies of the General Plan are unclear as to where short-term rentals in mixed-use zoned would be appropriate. 3. The existing zoning code for the Professional Office Zone as established in 2018 did not carry short-term rental use over from the R-M Zone into the PO Zone
motions.result: The motion passed with a vote of 6-to-1.
